name: StockImg AI
tagline: StockImg AI generates custom stock images, logos, book covers, posters, wallpapers, and UI designs from text prompts. Unlike standard stock photo sites, every image is unique and royalty-free. Teams use it to generate on-brand marketing visuals without paying per-image licensing fees.
